card.name: Matrix inverse text and unusual personal names
card.fires_on: Strongest on the word "of" right after "inverse" in matrix documentation (Mathematica Inverse). Also fires on pieces inside rare foreign or historical names, such as Amenophis, Megharagagik and Kathарина.

card.plain: It lights up in matrix-inverse documentation and inside unusual personal names, and it discourages the word identity.
